offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements to display per page. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported sorts are:

+ id: Sort by primary key

+ created_at: Sort by news creation datetime (operations: list)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

+ project_id: Filter news by project (operations: list)

title.description: The headline of the news (operations: create, update)

id.description: News id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete, get, update)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
